I am a **lecturer (Asisten Ahli)** in the [Department of Electrical Engineering](https://teknik-elektro.fst.unja.ac.id/) at [Universitas Jambi](https://www.unja.ac.id/). My work centers on **Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Pattern Recognition**, with a focus on making them useful outside the lab, whether for agriculture, health, or industry.

Before joining Universitas Jambi in 2024, I worked as a **Data Scientist** at **Alfagift** (Global Loyalty Indonesia) and **kumparan**, where I built forecasting systems, segmentation models, and ML pipelines used by millions of people.

I hold an **M.Kom. from Universitas Indonesia** and an **S.Komp. from IPB University**. My papers appear in Scopus-indexed and SINTA-accredited venues. See [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=OaPOYtEAAAAJ&hl=id) and [SINTA](https://sinta.kemdiktisaintek.go.id/authors/profile/6931115).

## Selected Research

<div class="section-label">Research</div>

My research follows problems that students and collaborators bring in. Four strands:

::: {.feature-grid}

::: {.feature-card}
### Pattern Recognition
<p>Reading scanned forms, counting fish from images, classifying satellite scenes and spotting malaria parasites.</p>
<div class="feature-meta">Vision · CNN · YOLO</div>
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Predictive Systems
<p>Forecasting with SARIMA and LSTM on energy exports and stock prices, and KNN-based trend analysis.</p>
<div class="feature-meta">Time series · SARIMA · LSTM</div>
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Clustering and Segmentation
<p>K-means and hierarchical methods for customer groups, province profiles and fire hotspots.</p>
<div class="feature-meta">K-means · Hierarchical</div>
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Intelligent Systems
<p>Small decision tools built for real users, from village IoT monitors to admin systems for pesantren.</p>
<div class="feature-meta">IoT · Decision support</div>
:::

:::
